hero.description: Track nutrition and activity with daily health data: what you eat, how much you move, how your weight changes, and how closely you follow your goals.
hero.secondary: The frontend is designed to connect to the backend through the /api/v1 gateway, prioritizing login, profile onboarding, daily dashboard, meal logs, activity logs, and analytics.

features.title: All screens needed for the first frontend phase
features.description: The interface focuses on workflows that users need first, keeping the product clear and ready for real API integration.

onboarding.title: Health profile onboarding
onboarding.description: Update height, weight, calorie goals, water goals, activity level, and health targets so the dashboard can be personalized.

meals.title: Meal diary
meals.description: Create breakfast, lunch, dinner, or snacks; add multiple foods to a meal and review calories, protein, carbs, fat, fiber, and sodium.

database.title: Food database
database.description: Search food by keyword, filter categories, check barcode data, review verified or pending status, and add missing foods.

activity.title: Physical activity
activity.description: Log cardio or strength sessions with duration, user weight, distance, heart rate, sets, reps, steps, and estimated calories burned.

metrics.title: Body metrics
metrics.description: Track weight, BMI, body fat, muscle mass, waist, hip, chest measurements, and daily notes.

analytics.title: Weekly and monthly analytics
analytics.description: View calories in/out, net calories, macro trends, streaks, and health progress over clear time ranges.

flow.title: The workflow follows the right implementation order
flow.description: Users start with an account, complete their profile, then log daily data. Dashboard and analytics become useful after the core logs are entered regularly.

security.authTitle: Auth guard and token flow are ready
security.authDescription: Unauthenticated users are redirected to login. Requests attach the bearer token automatically, and expired access tokens are refreshed before retrying.

security.apiDescription: Current sample data follows the expected backend payload shape, so each screen can swap local state for API calls when endpoints are ready.
